summary: Pretrained visual representations accelerate generative learning by abstracting away appearance and spatial detail. Yet the same abstraction makes the return to pixels far harder, shifting much of the burden onto a larger decoder.
takeaways: To learn these transitions without training a separate generator for each stage, we develop HyC-DiT, a unified generative model with a standard DiT backbone shared across stages and stage-specific condition injection.
RevFlow accelerates both learning and sampling.
Yet the same abstraction makes the return to pixels far harder, shifting much of the burden onto a larger decoder.
